requirements.title: Graduation rules {{cohort}} - {{major}}
requirements.help:
The roadmap optimizer only schedules the courses still missing under these rules. TOTAL_MIN: minimum total credits (the listed codes are excluded from the total). CHOOSE_ONE: alternatives separated by |, course codes within one alternative separated by commas. ELECTIVE_POOL: a group of elective courses with a minimum number of credits.
With no rules the roadmap schedules every course in the curriculum.
